extensions.name: statement description
extensions.value: The Republic of Ireland's Health Service Executive (HSE) has approved docetaxel in combination with carboplatin and trastuzumab (TCH, 21 days) for reimbursement as a treatment option for the adjuvant treatment of patients with HER2 positive early breast cancer. The European Medicines Agency product information for trastuzumab notes that trastuzumab should only be used in patients with metastatic or early breast cancer whose tumors have either HER2 overexpression or HER2 gene amplification as determined by an accurate and validated assay.
